nombre: Block of flats and shared areas
descripcion: The shared areas of a block of flats: entrance hall, stairs and landings, plant and bin rooms, car park without vehicles, storage room, roof terrace, light well and the leisure areas of a housing estate.

subcategorias.aparcado_en_portal: Things left parked in the hall
subcategorias.cosas_de_vecinos: What neighbours leave on the landing

casillero_buzones.descripcion: Block of letterboxes hung on the wall, from chest to head height. It sticks out a hand's width or more and the cane passes underneath without touching it. Each little door has its slot and its lock.
casillero_buzones.imagen: Footprint of “Bank of residents' letterboxes”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cb”.

buzones_exentos.descripcion: Letterbox unit standing on the floor on legs or a plinth. The cane finds the legs; the metal body starts at knee height.
buzones_exentos.imagen: Footprint of “Free-standing letterbox unit”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

taquillas_paqueteria.descripcion: Tall metal cabinet with doors of several sizes where couriers leave parcels. It has a keypad at chest height that beeps when the code is accepted.
taquillas_paqueteria.imagen: Footprint of “Parcel lockers in the hall”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

portero_automatico.descripcion: Metal plate on the wall by the door, with one button per flat in columns. It is at chest height and the cane does not touch it. Press and the bell rings upstairs.
portero_automatico.imagen: Footprint of “Entry phone panel”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.04 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

videoportero.descripcion: Panel with a number keypad instead of one button per flat: key in the flat and press the bell. The five key has a raised dot. It sticks out only a little from the wall.
videoportero.imagen: Footprint of “Video entry phone with keypad”: a rectangle, 0.18 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.15 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vi”.

tablon_comunidad.nombre: Residents' notice board with glazed case
tablon_comunidad.descripcion: Flat box with a glass door hung on the wall, where the managing agent posts notices. It sticks out at shoulder height and has sharp corners.
tablon_comunidad.imagen: Footprint of “Residents' notice board with glazed case”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tc”.

felpudo_encastrado.descripcion: Large mat of aluminium and rubber strips set in a pit, flush with the floor, just inside the door. It sounds different underfoot and feels rough: it tells you that you are inside.
felpudo_encastrado.imagen: Footprint of “Recessed entrance mat”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Fe”.

alfombra_pasillera.descripcion: Long narrow carpet running from the door to the lift. It feels soft underfoot and muffles your steps: following it takes you to the back of the hall. The edge may be curled up.
alfombra_pasillera.imagen: Footprint of “Hall runner carpet”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

espejo_portal.descripcion: Large mirror covering a stretch of wall almost from the floor. Smooth and cold to the touch; people with some sight think the hall carries on. It sounds like glass when struck.
espejo_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Full-length hall mirror”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.04 metres, hanging 0.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ep”.

banco_portal.descripcion: Built-in bench clad in marble, against the wall and with no backrest. Cold, hard and at knee height. Handy for putting bags down while you look for your key.
banco_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Marble hall bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

jardinera_portal.descripcion: Brick planter inside the hall, with large-leaved plants hanging into the way. You feel the leaves on your hand or face before the low wall.
jardinera_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Built-in hall planter”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Jp”.

mostrador_conserjeria.descripcion: Tall wooden desk behind which the concierge sits. It comes up to chest height. There is usually a radio on low: you hear it as you come in.
mostrador_conserjeria.imagen: Footprint of “Concierge desk”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

garita_conserje.descripcion: Small booth with glass walls from waist height up and a hatch. The lower part is wood; above, the glass is hard to see and sounds different when touched.
garita_conserje.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed concierge booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

carrito_compra_tela.descripcion: Fabric trolley bag with two wheels and a tall handle, left by the letterboxes. Soft at the top, metal frame below; push it and it rolls or tips over.
carrito_compra_tela.imagen: Footprint of “Parked shopping trolley bag”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

bici_pared_portal.nombre: Bike leaning against the hall wall
bici_pared_portal.descripcion: Bike leaning sideways against the wall. The handlebars and one pedal stick out into the way at hip and shin height. Brush against it and it may fall.
bici_pared_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Bike leaning against the hall wall”: a long thin body against the wall, with the handlebars sticking out near one end and a pedal in the middle, 1.75 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

peldanos_portal.descripcion: One, two or three marble steps across the full width, between the door and the lift. They do not block the way, but you must climb them; the edge is often slippery.
peldanos_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Entrance hall steps”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

rampa_portal.descripcion: Narrow ramp bypassing the entrance steps, with a tubular handrail on one side. The floor slopes and is rough rubber; the handrail guides you to the top.
rampa_portal.aviso: Entrance ramp: the handrail is on one side.
rampa_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Entrance ramp with handrail”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

puerta_portal.descripcion: Iron and glass door with a closer at the top that shuts it by itself. It is heavy: push with your body, and it swings back hard. The slam is heard all the way up the stairs.
puerta_portal.imagen: Footprint of “Heavy sprung entrance door”: a rectangle, 0.95 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

pulsador_abrepuertas.descripcion: Coin-sized button on the wall, one step from the door at elbow height. Press it and the lock buzzes: while it buzzes, the door opens with a push.
pulsador_abrepuertas.imagen: Footprint of “Door release button”: a rectangle, 0.08 by 0.03 metres, hanging 1.05 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

arranque_barandilla.descripcion: First run of the banister, with its post and knob. It reaches further into the landing than the first step: it is what the hand looks for to find where the stairs begin.
arranque_barandilla.imagen: Footprint of “Stair handrail newel”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

hueco_bajo_escalera.descripcion: The low part of the sloping underside of the stairs. The floor is clear and the cane finds nothing, but the ceiling drops to forehead and then chest height. Walk round it.
hueco_bajo_escalera.aviso: Mind your head: you are under the stairs.
hueco_bajo_escalera.imagen: Footprint of “Space under the stairs”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 1.50 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Hb”.

ventana_rellano_abierta.descripcion: Window sash open into the landing. Its edge is at face height and the cane passes underneath. Closed, it is no trouble; you feel the draught and hear outside noise when it is open.
ventana_rellano_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Landing window open inwards”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.04 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vr”.

armario_contadores_rellano.descripcion: Sheet-metal service cupboard in the landing wall, floor to ceiling, holding the meters for that floor. The door stands slightly proud and sounds hollow; sometimes it is left ajar.
armario_contadores_rellano.imagen: Footprint of “Landing meter cupboard”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

pulsador_luz_escalera.descripcion: Round button by each door and each flight. It turns the stair light on for a minute and it goes off by itself. On old timers you hear ticking while it lasts.
pulsador_luz_escalera.imagen: Footprint of “Timed stair light switch”: a circle, 0.08 by 0.04 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pl”.

bajante_vista.descripcion: Thick vertical plastic or iron pipe, floor to ceiling, in a corner. Now and then you hear water falling inside: it helps you recognise that corner.
bajante_vista.imagen: Footprint of “Exposed drainpipe”: a circle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

macetas_vecino.nombre: Neighbour's plant pots on the landing
macetas_vecino.descripcion: Cluster of clay pots of various sizes by a door. The leaves brush you first; small pots tip over under the cane.
macetas_vecino.imagen: Footprint of “Neighbour's plant pots on the landing”: an irregular patch against the wall: several pots of different sizes, 0.80 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

zapatos_vecino.descripcion: Row of shoes and boots on the floor beside a flat's doormat. Low and soft: the cane pushes them along and the foot trips on them.
zapatos_vecino.imagen: Footprint of “Neighbour's shoes by the door”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Zv”.

bolsa_basura_rellano.descripcion: Tied rubbish bag a neighbour has left by their door to take down later. Soft, it rustles when touched and it smells.
bolsa_basura_rellano.imagen: Footprint of “Rubbish bag on the landing”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

bombona_rellano.descripcion: Empty butane cylinder waiting for the delivery man. A steel cylinder at knee height with a handle on top; it rings like a bell when struck.
bombona_rellano.imagen: Footprint of “Gas cylinder on the landing”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

triciclo_rellano.nombre: Child's trike and scooter on the landing
triciclo_rellano.descripcion: A child's tricycle and scooter left by the door. Low and on wheels: they roll away if pushed and the handlebars are at thigh height.
triciclo_rellano.imagen: Footprint of “Child's trike and scooter on the landing”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

botonera_ascensor.descripcion: Small plate with one or two buttons on the lift door frame, at elbow height. The button is raised and sometimes has braille; press it and you hear the machinery start.
botonera_ascensor.imagen: Footprint of “Lift call panel”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 0.03 metres, hanging 0.95 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ba”.

puerta_ascensor_batiente.nombre: Swing door of an old lift
puerta_ascensor_batiente.descripcion: Iron door of an old lift, which opens by pulling it out into the landing. It is heavy, swings back by itself and takes up half the landing when open; it has a narrow glass slit.
puerta_ascensor_batiente.imagen: Footprint of “Swing door of an old lift”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

banqueta_ascensor.descripcion: Short, narrow wooden bench facing the lift, with no backrest, for waiting seated. Light: it shifts if you lean on it sideways.
banqueta_ascensor.imagen: Footprint of “Lift waiting bench”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.32 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

contadores_luz.descripcion: A whole wall of plastic modules with one meter per flat. Smooth, with sealed covers; it hums quietly all the time. Nothing here to touch.
contadores_luz.imagen: Footprint of “Bank of electricity meters”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

cuadro_electrico_saliente.descripcion: Sheet-metal box screwed to the wall at chest height, with the breakers inside. It sticks out a hand's width, has sharp corners and the cane passes underneath.
cuadro_electrico_saliente.imagen: Footprint of “Protruding fuse box”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.18 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

armario_telecomunicaciones.descripcion: Tall metal cabinet holding the aerial and fibre equipment. It has fans: it blows warm air through its grilles and you hear it from the door of the room.
armario_telecomunicaciones.imagen: Footprint of “Telecoms cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

contadores_agua.descripcion: A grid of iron pipes against the wall, with a row of meters and stopcocks sticking out at different heights. Cold and damp; you hear water running.
contadores_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Water meter manifold”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

grupo_presion.descripcion: Two pumps and a pressure vessel on a low plinth, covered in pipes and handwheels. They hum loudly when they start: you recognise the room from the corridor.
grupo_presion.imagen: Footprint of “Water booster set”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

caldera_comunitaria.descripcion: Large central heating boiler. A sheet-metal block that roars when the burner is lit and is hot to the touch, as are the pipes leaving it.
caldera_comunitaria.imagen: Footprint of “Communal boiler”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

deposito_gasoleo.descripcion: Long sheet-metal tank lying on legs, with rounded ends. It sounds hollow or full depending on the level and smells of heating oil: the smell warns you before the cane does.
deposito_gasoleo.imagen: Footprint of “Heating oil tank”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 2.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Dg”.

acumulador_agua_caliente.descripcion: Tall cylinder wrapped in insulation, standing next to the boiler. Soft outside and lukewarm; the pipes going in and out at top and bottom are hot.
acumulador_agua_caliente.imagen: Footprint of “Hot water cylinder”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

fila_cubos_comunidad.descripcion: Several wheelie bins lined up against the wall, one per kind of waste. You tell them apart by the lid: plain, with a round hole or with a slot. It smells, and the lid drops with a hollow bang.
fila_cubos_comunidad.imagen: Footprint of “Row of residents' wheelie bins”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.40 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Fc”.

cartones_plegados.descripcion: Stack of flattened cardboard boxes leaning on edge against the bin room wall. They slide and spill across the floor if you touch them.
cartones_plegados.imagen: Footprint of “Flattened cardboard against the wall”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

cubo_fregona.descripcion: Plastic bucket with a wringer and the mop in it, handle upwards. The handle is at chest height and falls over; the floor around is usually wet.
cubo_fregona.imagen: Footprint of “Mop and bucket”: an oval, 0.38 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

vertedero_limpieza.descripcion: Low ceramic sink at knee height, with a hinged grid to rest the bucket on and a tall tap above. The tap is at waist height.
vertedero_limpieza.imagen: Footprint of “Cleaner's sink”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Vl”.

escobas_apoyadas.nombre: Brooms and dustpan against the wall
escobas_apoyadas.descripcion: Two or three brooms and a long-handled dustpan leaning in a corner. The handles slip and clatter to the floor as soon as they are brushed.
escobas_apoyadas.imagen: Footprint of “Brooms and dustpan against the wall”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

ganchos_bicis.descripcion: Row of steel hooks screwed to the wall above head height, for hanging bikes by one wheel. When empty they stick out at forehead height and the cane gives no warning.
ganchos_bicis.imagen: Footprint of “Wall hooks for bikes”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gb”.

bici_colgada_gancho.nombre: Bike hung by its wheel from a hook
bici_colgada_gancho.descripcion: Bike hung upright on the wall: the top wheel on the hook and the bottom one near the floor. It reaches a metre out from the wall; the handlebars are at face height.
bici_colgada_gancho.imagen: Footprint of “Bike hung by its wheel from a hook”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.05 metres, hanging 0.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bc”.

soporte_bicis_suelo.descripcion: Low rail with wire slots that take the front wheel. Empty, it rises barely a hand's width from the floor: the cane finds it, but the foot trips and catches.
soporte_bicis_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Floor wheel rack for bikes”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Sb”.

columna_garaje_protegida.nombre: Car park column with corner guards
columna_garaje_protegida.descripcion: Square or oblong concrete pillar, wrapped up to waist height in foam rubber corner guards. Low down the knock is soft; above the waist, rough concrete.
columna_garaje_protegida.imagen: Footprint of “Car park column with corner guards”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

columna_garaje_redonda.descripcion: Round, smooth concrete pillar from floor to ceiling. It has no corners: you can walk round it without losing contact with your hand.
columna_garaje_redonda.imagen: Footprint of “Round car park column”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

rampa_garaje.descripcion: Stretch of grooved concrete ramp where cars drive up and down. The slope is steep and the surface rough; there is no pavement. If you hear an engine, keep to the wall.
rampa_garaje.aviso: Car park ramp: steep slope and cars may come.
rampa_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Car park ramp”: a rectangle, 3.50 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rg”.

rejilla_desague_garaje.descripcion: Narrow channel with an iron grating crossing the floor from side to side, at the foot of the ramp or by the door. It rings underfoot and the cane tip slips between the bars.
rejilla_desague_garaje.aviso: Grating: the cane tip may slip in.
rejilla_desague_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Car park drain channel”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rd”.

baden_garaje.descripcion: Rubber hump bolted to the floor across the lane. It rises three fingers: the cane feels it and the foot trips unless lifted.
baden_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Car park speed bump”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bg”.

mancha_aceite.nombre: Oil patch on the car park floor
mancha_aceite.descripcion: Oil patch left by a car in its bay. The cane does not feel it: the foot suddenly slips. It smells like a workshop.
mancha_aceite.imagen: Footprint of “Oil patch on the car park floor”: an irregular patch on the floor, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

marca_plaza_garaje.descripcion: Rectangle painted on the floor marking out a bay. Neither cane nor foot can feel the paint: when empty you cross it without noticing. Useful for laying out the car park.
marca_plaza_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Marked parking bay”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

tope_rueda_plaza.descripcion: Hard rubber bar bolted to the floor at the back of the bay, to stop the car hitting the wall. It rises barely a hand's width: with the bay empty it is a sure trip hazard.
tope_rueda_plaza.imagen: Footprint of “Parking bay wheel stop”: a rectangle, 1.65 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

punto_recarga_pared.descripcion: Plastic box on the wall at the back of the bay, at chest height, with a thick coiled cable that hangs down and sometimes crosses the floor. It hums while charging.
punto_recarga_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted car charger”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pr”.

armario_sobre_capo.descripcion: Sheet-metal cabinet at the back of the bay, raised on two side legs so the car's nose fits underneath. With the bay empty, the cane passes under it and the edge hits you in the chest.
armario_sobre_capo.imagen: Footprint of “Over-bonnet storage cabinet”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, hanging 1.15 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “As”.

trastero_jaula.nombre: Mesh storage cage in the car park
trastero_jaula.descripcion: Wire mesh cage from floor to ceiling, with a door and padlock, where a neighbour keeps belongings. The mesh gives a little and jingles when touched; the cane pokes through the gaps.
trastero_jaula.imagen: Footprint of “Mesh storage cage in the car park”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tj”.

puerta_basculante_garaje.descripcion: Large sheet-metal door opened upwards by a motor. As it opens, the leaf swings outwards at chest height before rising. It rattles, takes a few seconds and closes by itself.
puerta_basculante_garaje.aviso: Car park door: cars may come out.
puerta_basculante_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Up-and-over car park door”: a rectangle, 2.80 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

poste_pulsador_salida.descripcion: Slim metal post beside the lane, before the door, with a key switch and a button at car window height. Pressing it opens the big door.
poste_pulsador_salida.imagen: Footprint of “Car park exit button post”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

aviso_salida_vehiculos.nombre: Vehicle exit warning light and sounder
aviso_salida_vehiculos.descripcion: Small box on the façade above the car park door, which beeps and flashes while the door moves. It is above head height: no obstacle, but it warns that a car is about to come out.
aviso_salida_vehiculos.imagen: Footprint of “Vehicle exit warning light and sounder”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.15 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “As”.

puerta_cortafuegos.descripcion: Thick sheet-metal door, smooth and cold, with a stiff handle and a strong closer. You must pull or push hard and it slams shut by itself with a boom.
puerta_cortafuegos.imagen: Footprint of “Fire door”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

vestibulo_independencia.descripcion: Small empty room between two fire doors, between the car park and the stairs. It holds little more than one person and sounds boxed in: close the first door to open the second comfortably.
vestibulo_independencia.imagen: Footprint of “Fire lobby”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Vi”.

tuberias_bajas_garaje.nombre: Low pipes hanging from the car park ceiling
tuberias_bajas_garaje.descripcion: A bundle of pipes crossing the way, hung from the ceiling lower than the rest. It is at a tall person's forehead height and the cane does not find it. It sometimes drips.
tuberias_bajas_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Low pipes hanging from the car park ceiling”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

conducto_ventilacion_bajo.descripcion: Wide sheet-metal duct hung from the ceiling, with grilles blowing or sucking air. Lower than the beams: it sounds hollow, like a drum, if touched with a raised hand.
conducto_ventilacion_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low sheet-metal ventilation duct”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.85 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cv”.

extractor_garaje.descripcion: Large sheet-metal box with a fan inside, in a corner or behind a grille. It roars so much that it drowns other sounds: a good landmark, but near it you cannot hear cars.
extractor_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Car park extractor fan”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Eg”.

espejo_convexo_garaje.descripcion: Round, bulging mirror on an arm, fixed to the wall or a column at junctions. It is at head height and sticks out: the cane does not detect it.
espejo_convexo_garaje.imagen: Footprint of “Convex car park mirror”: an oval, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ec”.

boca_incendio_equipada.descripcion: Sheet-metal cabinet with a glass door and a coiled hose inside, hung on the wall at waist height. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane does not touch it.
boca_incendio_equipada.imagen: Footprint of “Fire hose reel cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.22 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bi”.

extintor_carro.descripcion: Large extinguisher on two wheels, with a hose and a handle for dragging it. Waist high, made of steel and sounding full; it stands by a column or the wall.
extintor_carro.imagen: Footprint of “Wheeled fire extinguisher”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

estanteria_metalica_trastero.descripcion: Bolted steel-angle shelving with sheet-metal shelves full of boxes. The edges are sharp and things stick out from the shelves at different heights.
estanteria_metalica_trastero.imagen: Footprint of “Metal storage-room shelving”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

cajas_carton_apiladas.descripcion: Tower of removal boxes, one on another, not always neatly aligned. They sound hollow or full; push the bottom one and the tower wobbles.
cajas_carton_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked cardboard boxes”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

maletas_apiladas.descripcion: Two or three hard suitcases lying flat on top of each other. Smooth, with wheels and handles sticking out on one side; they sound hollow.
maletas_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked suitcases”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

bolsas_ropa_guardada.descripcion: Large woven bags full of clothes and blankets, piled on the floor. Soft: they give when touched and the cane sinks in without a sound.
bolsas_ropa_guardada.imagen: Footprint of “Bags of stored clothes”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

neumaticos_apilados.descripcion: Column of four car tyres lying flat. Treaded rubber outside and a hole in the middle; it smells of rubber and makes no sound when struck.
neumaticos_apilados.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked tyres”: a circle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Na”.

muebles_tapados_sabana.nombre: Old furniture under a dust sheet
muebles_tapados_sabana.descripcion: A large, irregular mass covered with a cloth: underneath are stacked chairs, a chest of drawers, a bed base. Soft at first touch and hard beneath; you cannot guess its shape.
muebles_tapados_sabana.imagen: Footprint of “Old furniture under a dust sheet”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

botes_pintura_suelo.descripcion: Half a dozen tins and jerrycans on the floor by the wall. Low and made of tinplate: they clang under the cane and roll if knocked over.
botes_pintura_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Paint tins on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

arbol_navidad_caja.descripcion: Long cardboard box standing on end in a corner, with the dismantled Christmas tree inside. Light: it topples at the slightest push, and the decorations jingle inside.
arbol_navidad_caja.imagen: Footprint of “Christmas tree in its box”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “An”.

escalera_apoyada.descripcion: Aluminium ladder leaning against the wall, with its feet one step out. The cane finds the feet; the rails rise at an angle and slide sideways if pushed.
escalera_apoyada.imagen: Footprint of “Ladder leaning against the wall”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

colchon_de_pie.descripcion: Mattress stored on edge against the wall. As tall as a person and soft: it leans over onto you if you touch it near the top.
colchon_de_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Mattress standing against the wall”: a rectangle, 1.35 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

esquis_sombrilla_rincon.nombre: Skis and parasol propped in the corner
esquis_sombrilla_rincon.descripcion: Long thin things standing in a corner: skis, a beach parasol, fishing rods. They slide and fall across the floor as soon as they are brushed.
esquis_sombrilla_rincon.imagen: Footprint of “Skis and parasol propped in the corner”: a quarter circle with its corner at the back left, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

bici_colgada_techo.descripcion: Bike hung from two ceiling hooks, lying over the way. The wheels and pedals are at head height and the cane passes underneath.
bici_colgada_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Bike hung from the ceiling”: a rectangle, 1.75 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bc”.

tirador_luz_trastero.descripcion: Cord hanging from the ceiling bulb, with a little ball on the end. It brushes your face as you enter: find it with a raised hand and pull to switch on.
tirador_luz_trastero.imagen: Footprint of “Storage room light pull cord”: a circle, 0.04 by 0.04 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tl”.

cuerdas_tender_azotea.descripcion: Several parallel lines stretched from post to post, at neck or face height. Empty, they make no sound and the cane misses them: you find them with your throat.
cuerdas_tender_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Roof terrace washing lines”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 1.20 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ct”.

poste_tendedero.descripcion: Iron tube post from which the washing lines run, with a crossbar on top. Finding it with the cane warns you that the lines start there.
poste_tendedero.imagen: Footprint of “Washing line post”: a circle, 0.06 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

sabanas_tendidas.descripcion: Sheets hanging from the line, from neck to knees. Damp and soft: push them aside with your hand and walk through, but they muffle sounds and snap in the wind.
sabanas_tendidas.aviso: Washing on the line: push it aside with your hand.
sabanas_tendidas.imagen: Footprint of “Sheets on the line”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.05 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “St”.

tendedero_aspa.descripcion: An airer like an umbrella turned inside out: a mast set in the ground and four arms with lines at face height. It turns when pushed; the cane only finds the mast in the middle.
tendedero_aspa.imagen: Footprint of “Rotary clothes airer”: a diamond, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ta”.

tendedero_ventana_bajo.descripcion: Frame of iron rods jutting from a low window into the yard. It is at chest height, with the ends pointing outwards, and the cane passes underneath.
tendedero_ventana_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Ground-floor window clothes rack”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tv”.

cuerdas_poleas_patio.descripcion: Lines crossing the light well from window to window, above head height. They are not in the way, but the washing drips and wets the floor below. The pulleys squeak when a neighbour hangs washing.
cuerdas_poleas_patio.imagen: Footprint of “Pulley washing lines between windows”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.60 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cp”.

sumidero_patio.descripcion: Small iron grating at the lowest point of the yard. The floor slopes towards it from all sides: feeling that underfoot tells you where the middle is.
sumidero_patio.imagen: Footprint of “Yard floor drain”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

grifo_patio_manguera.descripcion: Tap on the wall at knee height, with a hose coiled on a bracket or on the ground. There is usually a puddle beneath; with the tap on you hear the jet.
grifo_patio_manguera.imagen: Footprint of “Yard tap with coiled hose”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

manguera_extendida.descripcion: Rubber hose snaking across the ground from the tap. Two fingers thick: the cane skips over it, the foot catches and the ground around is wet.
manguera_extendida.imagen: Footprint of “Hose lying across the ground”: a band snaking from one side to the other, 4.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

pila_lavar_patio.descripcion: Stone or cement trough with a sloping, ribbed front for scrubbing clothes, on two low walls. Hip high; there is a gap underneath.
pila_lavar_patio.imagen: Footprint of “Yard wash trough”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

murete_azotea.descripcion: Brick parapet closing the edge of the roof or dividing one terrace from the neighbour's. Chest high, it protects; if only knee high, there may be a drop behind it.
murete_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Roof terrace parapet”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

claraboya_azotea.nombre: Raised skylight on the roof terrace
claraboya_azotea.descripcion: Plastic dome on a low kerb in the middle of the roof: it lights the stairwell. It rises a hand's width or two, sounds hollow and will not bear a person's weight.
claraboya_azotea.aviso: Skylight: do not step on it.
claraboya_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Raised skylight on the roof terrace”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

caseton_azotea.descripcion: Brick housing where the stairs come out onto the roof, with the lift machine room above. It is the roof's main landmark: where you come out and where you go back.
caseton_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Stair and lift roof housing”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

chimenea_ventilacion.descripcion: Brick stack as tall as a person, with a metal cowl that spins in the wind and squeaks. Kitchen smells come out of it.
chimenea_ventilacion.imagen: Footprint of “Ventilation stack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

antena_con_vientos.descripcion: Aerial mast held by three steel wires running down at an angle to anchors in the floor. The wires cross the way at any height, from feet to head.
antena_con_vientos.aviso: Aerial wires: they cross at any height.
antena_con_vientos.imagen: Footprint of “Aerial mast with guy wires”: a triangle pointing to the front, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

escalera_gato.descripcion: Vertical ladder of iron rungs fixed to the wall, for climbing to the housing or a roof. It stands a hand's width proud; sometimes it starts halfway up and the cane misses it.
escalera_gato.imagen: Footprint of “Fixed wall ladder”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Eg”.

aire_acondicionado_suelo.nombre: Outdoor air conditioning unit on the floor
aire_acondicionado_suelo.descripcion: Sheet-metal box on rubber feet, with a grille blowing out hot air. It hums and vibrates when running; knee to hip high. It drips underneath.
aire_acondicionado_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Outdoor air conditioning unit on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

aire_acondicionado_mensulas.nombre: Air conditioning unit on brackets at head height
aire_acondicionado_mensulas.descripcion: Air conditioning unit bolted to the wall on two brackets, at face height. The cane passes underneath; only the hum and the drops falling on the ground warn you.
aire_acondicionado_mensulas.imagen: Footprint of “Air conditioning unit on brackets at head height”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.32 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Aa”.

deposito_agua_azotea.descripcion: Round fibre tank on a plinth, with a lid and pipes. It sounds hollow or full depending on the level; you hear the water coming in as it fills.
deposito_agua_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Roof water tank”: a circle, 1.30 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Da”.

placas_solares_azotea.descripcion: Row of glass panels tilted on an aluminium frame. The low edge is at shin height and the high edge at chest height; in the sun they are hot.
placas_solares_azotea.imagen: Footprint of “Solar panels on frames”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

piscina_comunidad.descripcion: The estate's pool, level with the ground and kidney-shaped. The edge is a rounded, rough coping stone: when you step on it, stop. You hear water in the overflow.
piscina_comunidad.imagen: Footprint of “Residents' swimming pool”: a kidney: an oval with a dent in one of its long sides, 8.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

valla_piscina.descripcion: Fence of vertical bars round the pool, chest high, to keep unaccompanied children out. Follow it with your hand until you reach the gate.
valla_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Pool fence”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

puerta_valla_piscina.descripcion: Barred gate in the fence, with the latch right at the top, out of children's reach. It opens outwards and a spring shuts it with a clang.
puerta_valla_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Self-closing pool gate”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

lavapies_piscina.descripcion: A built-in pool a hand's width deep, just inside the pool gate, which you must wade through. One step down, cold water underfoot and one step up.
lavapies_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Pool footbath”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Lp”.

ducha_jardin_piscina.descripcion: Steel post with a shower head on top and a push button at hand height, over a slatted tray. It gives cold water for a few seconds and stops by itself. The ground around is slippery.
ducha_jardin_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Poolside garden shower”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Dj”.

aro_salvavidas_poste.descripcion: Wooden post with a lifebuoy hung at chest height and a coiled rope. The ring is hard hollow plastic and sticks out either side of the post.
aro_salvavidas_poste.imagen: Footprint of “Lifebuoy on its post”: a T shape, 0.70 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

tumbona_comunidad.descripcion: Low, long plastic sun lounger with the back raised. Residents move it: it is somewhere different each day. Light, it shifts under the cane.
tumbona_comunidad.imagen: Footprint of “Estate poolside sun lounger”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

caseta_depuradora.descripcion: Low masonry housing half sunk beside the pool, with a sheet-metal lid or door. Inside the pump hums all summer and it smells of chlorine: you hear it from afar.
caseta_depuradora.imagen: Footprint of “Pool filter housing”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

pergola_urbanizacion.descripcion: Roof of timber beams and reed matting on four posts. Beneath it there is shade, it is cooler and the sound changes. The beams are above head height; the posts are placed separately.
pergola_urbanizacion.imagen: Footprint of “Timber pergola”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pu”.

poste_pergola.descripcion: Square timber post, as thick as a leg, holding up the pergola or a porch. There are usually four; sometimes a climbing plant brushes you first.
poste_pergola.imagen: Footprint of “Pergola post”: a rectangle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

barbacoa_obra.descripcion: Brick barbecue with a shelf on each side, the grill at waist height and a hood with a chimney above. When lit, the embers crackle and it smells of smoke: it is hot.
barbacoa_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Brick barbecue”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Bo”.

banco_obra_ele.descripcion: Brick bench turning a corner, with no backrest or with the wall as one. Rough and at knee height; a table usually sits in the inner angle.
banco_obra_ele.imagen: Footprint of “Built-in L-shaped bench”: an L shape, 3.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bo”.

pista_petanca.descripcion: Long rectangle of fine gravel enclosed by a timber kerb a hand's width high. Step over it; inside, the ground crunches. You hear the steel boules clack together.
pista_petanca.imagen: Footprint of “Boules court with kerb”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 12.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

camino_losas_cesped.descripcion: Line of stone slabs laid on the lawn, from the gate to the pool. It feels hard underfoot against the soft grass: following it gets you there without getting lost.
camino_losas_cesped.imagen: Footprint of “Stepping-stone path across the lawn”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

caseta_jardinero.descripcion: Board shed with a pitched roof where the lawnmower and tools are kept. The wood sounds hollow; the eaves are at a tall person's head height.
caseta_jardinero.imagen: Footprint of “Gardener's shed”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cj”.

garita_vigilante.descripcion: Small many-sided hut by the vehicle entrance, with windows all round. The guard usually has the radio on: you hear it before you get there.
garita_vigilante.imagen: Footprint of “Estate security booth”: an octagon, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Gv”.

barrera_urbanizacion.descripcion: Long aluminium arm across the vehicle lane at waist height; it comes out of a motor cabinet. The cane passes under the arm. It rises with a hum and comes down by itself.
barrera_urbanizacion.imagen: Footprint of “Estate lifting barrier”: a narrow cabinet on the left and a long thin arm reaching out of it to the right, 3.00 by 0.35 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bu”.

cancela_peatonal.descripcion: Barred iron gate in the street railings, with the entry phone on the pier beside it. It buzzes when someone opens from home and shuts by itself with a clang.
cancela_peatonal.imagen: Footprint of “Estate pedestrian gate”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.
